children: CSE Global's outlook appears upbeat to UOB Kay Hian analysts, citing the company's expectation of more data-center contract wins by end-2026. The Singapore technology company's data-center exposure to U.S. government end-users provides insulation against funding risks, given their relatively low credit risk and long-term project commitments, the analysts say. The company's work with a second so-called hyperscaler offers further growth opportunities as the company expands its presence in the U.S., they add. They expect CSE Global to post stronger 2H margins as start-up costs at some facilities normalize. UOB Kay Hian maintains its buy rating and 1.79 Singapore dollar target price. Shares last closed at S$0.935. (megan.cheah@wsj.com)
